tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// dpal gsang ba'i bdag po 'byung po 'dul byed gyi sgo nas las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bya tshul dngos grub nor bu 'dren pa'i gru chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 'di nyid rgyud sde gong 'og gi dbye ba phyed par byas na lhag pa'i lha phal cher la sbyar du rung ngo*// ༄༅// na mo gu ru sh+tsa shrīḥgu h+ya s+ya pa ti badz+ra pā ṇi bhū ta ḍā ma rā ya/ bho ṭa'i ljongs 'dir mkhas dang grub pa'i rtsal// yongs su rdzogs pa sa skya'i 'jam mgon lnga// brgyud 'dzin mkhas grub srid na 'gran bral bcas// mi phyed dad pa brtan pos lan brgyar bsngags// dus gsum rgyal ba'i mthu stobs nus pa kun// sa gsum 'byung po'i gshed du hūm̐ gi gzugs// khams gsum las rgyal gtum chen khro bo yi// gsang gsum yid la dran pas 'dir phyag bya// rab 'byams rgyud sde'i chu gter klong yangs nas// rab 'bar khro bo'i phrin las rnam bzhi'i grus// rab mchog grub gnyis bsam 'phel nor bu'i skyes// rab myur 'dren pa'i thabs tshul 'di na dge /zhes mchod par brjod pa'i tshig gis lam cung zad phyes te/ 'dir rang gzhan mtha' dag rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung lugs la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs cher ma bcad pa'i dbang gis rgyud sde'i gzhung chen po rnams nas bshad pa'i las bzhi'i phrin las sgrub tshul rnams ji lta ba bzhin lag tu'ang ma lon/ dkor nag blos ma thongs pas mi shes zer yang ma 'dod pa rnams kyis o zob dang*/ mun pa'i nang gi mda' 'phen zung 'brel byas nas/ gzhan mgo 'gal me ltar bskor ba de rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang yang 'gal zhing*/ 'di phyi kun la mi legs par mthong nas/ dpal gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i las bzhi'i me mchod kyi rim pa nag 'gros su bri bar byed pa la/ grangs med zhi bsil thugs rje'i zla 'od kyis// mi mthun sgrib pa'i snying mun mthar byas te// dge mtshan 'bum gyi phan bde'i ku mud zhal// rnam par dbye ba'i tshul de dang por dge

/de yang dang por 'di'i bsnyen pa las rung song ba'i dam ldan gyis rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib zhi ba'i phyir zhi ba'i sreg blugs ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba la/ sbyor ba thab dang bud shing sbar ba me// rdzas dang bsham thabs sgrub pa po ste drug /ces sdom du byas pa ltar gyi dang po thab ni/ nyams dga' zhing sa'i cho ga byas pa'i sa phyogs su rang nyid kha shar du bltas nas 'dug chog rtsis kyi mdun gyi gzhi der thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab pa la/ khru phyed kyis dbus nas zlum por bskor ba ni thab kyi dngos gzhi dang*/ de'i phyi rol du sor bzhi bskor ba kha khyer dang*/ slar yang sor bzhi bskor ba mu ran dang*/ tshad de nyid kyis tshangs thig dang mu ran 'dzom pa'i sa nas zur thig bzhi'i steng du mtshan ma byas la thig bzhi'i rtse legs par sbrel ba'i stegs bu gru bzhi pa/ de'i grwa bzhir rdo rje'i rtse nang ngos su bstan pa'i zla phyed rdo rje bya/ phyag len la stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i phyi rol du'ang sor bzhi'i tshad kyi cha ga gru bzhi pa mdzad pa ni bris cha la mig sngar mdzes pa dang*/ sgom don la stegs bu'i dpangs kyi tshad yin gsungs/ thab kyi dbus nas sum gnyis phyir bzhag pa'i nang gi sum cha zlum por bskor ba la pad+ma'i lte ba dang*/ phyi'i sum gnyis la pad+ma'i 'dab ma bya zhing*/ thab kyi gzhi thams cad kha dog dkar po bya/ kha khyer ram mu ran gang rung la rdo rje kha zum pa'i phreng bas bskor/ kha dog 'dres pa'i

sgrub khang pa mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub kyis/ las bzhi'i thab la kha dog dkar po sogs las mdog 'ba' zhig tu bshad pas 'dres pa'i skyon med/ des na dmar skya sogs kyis bcad par gsungs pa ni mig sngar mdzes chos tsam las mtha' gcig tu dgos pa min zhes gsungs/ skyon spang ba'i phyir/ bcad tshon thams cad dang rdo rje kha dog dmar skyas bya/ pad+ma'i lte bar nyi gdan gyi steng du tshom bu sngon po dgod/ gnyis pa bud shing ni/ tsher ma can ma yin pa'i shing ngam 'om bu dang*/ lcang dkar/ bal bu sogs/ de med na srog chags med pa'i lci bas thab kyi kha khyer gyi steng nas zlum por brtsigs la nang gi shar lho'i mtshams su ting lo che ba zhig kyang bshams la gzhag go /gsum pa sbar ba me ni/ rdo dang lcags gtsubs pa las byung ba ma yin pa bram ze'i rgyun bzhag gi me'am/ 'o ma can gtsubs pa sogs las byung ba'o// bzhi pa rdzas ni/ ya 1 ma shing rgyu bud shing dang 'dra/ tshad sor brgyad pa/ rtse mo mar khus nyug pa'o/ mar 2 til 3 zas mchog 4 dang*/ mngar gsum bsres pa'i zho zan/ /so ba 5 'bra 6 sa na 7 sa gro 8 dang ni// sra 9 na ma dkar po/ dūr+wa 10 dngos sam rtswa ran pa/ ku 11 sha rtsa rtse ma nyams pa rnams// zhes sdom du byas pa ltar dang*/ gzhan yang dkar gtor zlum po 'dab can gnyis/ mchod 'bru/ spos/ mar me/ zhal zas/ ting lo/ dpal 'bar/ ku sha dgram rgyu dang 'thor yab/ dri bzang sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams gtsang zhing gya nom pa sta gon bya'o// lnga pa bsham thabs ni/ thab kyi mtha' skor thams cad byi dor legs par byas la dri bzang pos byug thab kyi nub tu rang gi stan nang tshangs can dkar po zhig gding*/ rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas phyogs na stegs mtho ba'i steng du/ 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das kyi gtor ma gnyis po dang*/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/

rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon ngos na stegs ji ltar rigs pa la/ rdzas rnams gong du bshad pa'i go rim bzhin bsham/ rang gi mdun du bsang chu'i snod/ 'thor yab/ rdor dril/ nang mchod rnams dang*/ rdor dril gyi bar du dgang gzar blugs gzar kha sbyar la gzhag so sor gzhag mi rung ngo*// grub na thab dang sgrub pa po'i bar du 'jim pa las byas pa'i me yol dkar zhal gyis byugs pa'ang 'jim pa'am rdo la dkar zhal gyis byugs shing gangs ri'i gzugs chu rgyun 'khyil ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su wam̐ yig bris pa bzhag pa me'i dug srung ba'i slad gangs ti ser mos zhes gsung rgyun las 'byung*/ bshams la/ rdzas thams cad la bdud rtsi lngas 'thor la gzhag go /drug pa sgrub pa po ni/ phyi ma red kyi dus su rang nyid khrus byas 'byor na gos dang rgyan dkar pos brgyan la sdig pa dang bar chad zhi bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas sngar bshams pa'i stan la kha shar du bltas te skyil krung gis 'dug go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor me btsal yo byad bsang*// thab khung 'du bya 'jig rten me lha mchod// 'das pa'i me lha mchod rnams dngos gzhi'i chos// zhes pa ltar drug las dang po bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsam gyi bar ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i bdag bskyed bzhin bya'o// 'di nas brtsams te sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub kyi bar la/ lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' ba la bslab bo// gnyis pa me btsal zhing sgrub pa ni/ dpal 'bar che ba zhig la gong du bshad pa'i me sbar te yam shing mar la sbags pa'am/ rtswa skam po gzhan dang bcas pa'i lag pa gnyis kas gus pa'i tshul gyis thab la g.yas nas zlum por bskor zhing*/ ngag tu/ hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa lan gsum dang*/

oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod de thab kyi nang gi ting lo sbar la me gso/ de nas khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa'i mdzub mo brkyang ba byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung la/ blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg cing blugs gzar gyi mar khus bud shing la khyab par blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod/ gsum pa thab dang yo byad bsang ba ni/ bsang chu la dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sham̐ las byung ba'i dung phor dri ma med pa'i nang du/ bsang chu rdzas dang yo byad rnams kyis 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa lan bdun gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ de nas ku sha'i 'thor yab kyis rdzas dang yo byad thab bcas la 'thor zhing*/ a mṛ te brjod pas bgegs bsal/ swa bhā was bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas rnams stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur bar bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hās yam shing*/ oṃ shrī swā hās mar/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hās 'bru/ oṃ swa swā hās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas thams cad sbyangs/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da'i bar dang*/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta sogs rol mo bcas kyi byin gyis brlab bo// bzhi pa thab khung mngon par 'du bya ba ni/ thab swa bhā was stong par sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa kha khyer ram mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan pa/

phyi rol du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam mo// lnga pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las me lha ra skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ gsus khyim che ba ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ ag tshom 'phyang ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ de nas lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar gzhag mdzub mos gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ag+na ye ma hā te dzaḥ sarba karma pra sā dha ka ma hā bhū ta de wa ṛ ṣi dwi dza sa ta ma/ gṛ hī twā a hu tiṃ ā ha ra asmin san+ni hi to bha wa zhes sam/ oṃ ag+na ye e h+ye hi zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod la pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas chu gnyis dbul/ de nas rdo rje spos dang bcas pas dril bu bzung la/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wā la ya sarba bha smīṃ ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭā na hūm̐ phaṭ dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod pa'i mthar/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod nas thab dbus kyi dam tshig pa la bstim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas dbang lha spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa'i mtshan sngags re re mgor sbyar ba'i puṣ+pe sogs kyis nyer spyod lnga/ shab+da dang gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes btags pas nang mchod dang*/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa thams cad sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams te/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yin ni dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig /oṃ badz+ra satwa a/ zhes brjod de thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas skor du dgram mo// de nas gzar bu gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ste/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐ dang*/

dgang blugs kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang ram̐ gyis mtshan par bsams te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī pyā dī bya ma hā shrī ye ha ka bya ba ha nā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul la bar der me pra brtags te ngan na hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsang chus phyogs kun tu gtor te bgegs bsal lo// de nas oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod la bsreg rdzas rnams rim bzhin 'bul dgos pas/ thog mar rdzas rnams lag pa g.yon pas bzung la/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas blang zhing cung zad bskor te mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul/ de yang yam shing byang chub kyi shing du mos te/ oṃ ag+na ye lha sngags swā hā/ oṃ bo dhi rdzas sngags bṛk+ṣā ya bdag gis las sngags tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas tshar gcig dang*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā lan lnga/ yang lha sngags rdzas sngags/ las sngags spel ba tshar gcig bcas khyon bdun nam/ nyer gcig sogs 'bul na'ang des rigs 'gre/ spel tshig skabs sbyin bdag gi don du yin na/ sbyin pa'i bdag po'i 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes sbyar la bya'o// de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la yang de'i rigs pas shes par byas la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pas mar dang*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hā zhes pas til lam yungs kar dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hās zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hās 'bras so dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ya swā hās 'bras dang*/

oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hās nas dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hās gro dang*/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hās sran ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hās dūr+wa dang*/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya swā hās ku sha rnams phul la/ sde tshan re re'i gong 'og tu lha sngags/ rdzas sngags/ las sngags sogs sbyor tshul shes par bya'o// de ltar me lha la bsreg rdzas ji tsam 'byor pa phul ba'i mthar gong ltar mchod bstod byas la/ yang gong bzhin oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis chu gnyis dbul/ mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod la/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo// drug pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su dri ma med pa'i hūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin la/ rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor/ sku las mdangs dang*/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs nas/ sa mā dzaḥzhes pa'i bar yang sgrub thabs bzhin la/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ'i skabs rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdor dril 'dzin pas/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa yi// chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang*// thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// zhes sam/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// zhes sogs spyi ltar gyi mthar/ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes brjod la spyan drangs/ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sogs dbang lha spyan 'dren sgrub thabs bzhin las/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba zhes par 'di la zhes bsgyur nas/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/

lha de nyid 'dzum zhing zhi ba dang*/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsams la/ slar yang hūm̐ zhes brjod cing thab dang yo byad thams cad la bsang chus gtor te mi gtsang ba dang*/ nyes pa thams cad dag par bsam mo// de nas gzar bu gnyis blangs te lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs par bsam pa sogs sngar ltar gsal btab ste/ hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa ces tshar kha shas brjod/ de nas oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pa lan bdun gyis blugs gzar gyis mar blugs pas dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī pyā dī bya zhes sogs kyi mthar/ bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i zhes sogs spel tshig gong ltar brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam/ de lta bu gsum la sogs pas byon skyems phul la/ de nas oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs mtshan sngags re re bzhin sbyar ba'i nyer spyod rol mo bcas kyis mchod/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod dbul/ dpal chen nam mkha'i sogs dang*/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa nas sogs sh+lo ka gnyis kyis bstod/ de nas yam shing sngar bzhin bzung ste/ hūm̐ badz+ra lha sngags phaṭa tshar gsum tsam dang*/ oṃ bo dhi

rdzas sngags bṛk+ṣā ya bdag gis las sngags sogs gong bzhin dang bcas te tshar gcig dang*/ de nas oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā rkyang pas ji tsam 'os pa phul ba'i mthar/ slar yang hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya bdag gis sogs tshar gcig dbul/ de bzhin du rdzas gzhan ma rnams la yang rigs 'gres te shes par bya zhing*/ grangs ni brgya rtsa la sogs pa dbul zhing sgrub g.yog gis grangs bzung la/ bsnyen pa kha gso ba la sogs pa'i dus su nub re la khyad par gyi rdzas til stong phrag lnga'am khri la sogs pa ci tsam nus pa dbul zhing*/ sngags ni las rgyas pa gtso bor byed na rdzas sngags sarba pā paṃ da ha na dang*/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong dang mchog sgrub pa gtso bor byed na lha sngags la grangs gzung zhing mtshams su spel tshig sbyar/ gzhan yang gdon bgegs zhi ba tsam gyi ched yin na til gyi tshab yungs kar gyis bya zhing*/ sngags sarba pā paṃ gyi tshab tu/ bgegs zhi ba la/ oṃ sarba bigh+nan da ha na badz+rā ya swā hā zhes sbyar/ des mtshon te/ gdon la sarba duṣ+ṭān da ha sogs/ nad la sarba ro ga rims la sarba dz+wa ra/ nye bar 'tshe ba la sarba u pa dra bya/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba la sarba a kā la mṛ t+yu/ rmi lam ngan pa la/ sarba dur+sop+na/ ltas ngan pa la/ sarba durmi ta/ rnam par g.yeng ba la/ sarba tsit+ta ku la zhes pa lta bur bsgyur zhing*/ spel tshig bod skad kyang brjod/ skabs skabs su yam shing dang mar ci 'byor pa dbul/ sgrub g.yog gcig gis me rgyun ma chad tsam gyi bud shing yang gzhug go /de yang yam shing ni me 'od 'bar ba la/ zhu ba'i rdzas rnams ni lha'i zhal du/ gong bu'i rdzas rnams ni phyag tu/ ku sha ni dbu'i gtsug tor la phul bar bsam mo// bsreg rdzas rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ gong byon skyems kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang gzar gsum dbul/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs te/ phyi mchod rnams/

dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di// zhes dang*/ zhabs bsil 'di zer nas 'don pa bsgyur ba ma gtogs gzhan kye rdor bzhin bya ba'am/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas las kyi dngos grub stsol// oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ rol mo dang*/ shab+da'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ bsdu na sngags mchod rkyang pas kyang rung la/ gong bzhin nang mchod dang bstod pa bcas pa'ang bya'o// de nas gtor ma dang po la chab kyis bran te/ a mṛ tes bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i a kā ro btags pa lan gsum sogs kyis dbul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi nang gi mchod pa/ bstod pa bcas kyi mthar/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar bya/ mthar thal mo sbyar la/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs rang gi yid la 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang zhes sogs dang*/ bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas sems sgrib pa dang ldan pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang gis cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa thams cad bzod par mdzad du gsol/

oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad ces sogs kyi rjes la grub na gur nas bshad pa'i yi ge brgya pa bzlas te mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥzhes dang*/ mtheb srin gyi se gol gyi sgras/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ srin lag gis thab kyi dbus nas thal ba cung zad blangs la dpral bar bskus te/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// gsum pa rjes la/ me lha lhag mas 1 mchod dang gtor 2 ma gtong*// 'dod don zhus 3 la gshegs gsol 4 lhag chad bskang 5 *// las kyi rjes 6 bsdu ba ste drug yin no// zhes pa ltar las dang po me lha lhag mas mchod pa ni/ thab khung du mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg pa dang bcas pas blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod de/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsams la bsreg rdzas rnams kyi lhag ma bdun nam bcu gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor phul mthar/ byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gang ba'i sbyin sreg tu dbul/ yon bdag la sogs pa'i don du byed pa'i tshe/ spro zhing nus na/ de'i lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong dgang gzar dang lhan cig tu bzung la gang ba'i sbyin sreg phul ba'i mthar/ bdag gam yon bdag che ge mo zhes bgyi ba'i nad dang*/ gdon dang*/ bkra mi shis pa dang*/ byur dang*/ skal pa ngan pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes bdun tshan gsum po re re'i mthar bya bar yang gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ gtor ma gnyis pa de nyid la chab kyis bran te/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan gsum la sogs pas byin gyis brlab/ lag pa gnyis mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogs gsum mam lngas phul la/

mthar mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyi mthar spro na/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir// thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul pa// rig sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul// nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od// bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan// thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa chibs// rig sngags gsung zhing bgrang phreng 'dzin// bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan gun+dhe bsnams// chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil// nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod// 'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das// zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che// de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ gsum pa ni/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i zhes sogs 'dod don gsol ba gong ltar bya'o// bzhi pa dang lnga pa go rim cung zad kha bsgyur te/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskangs la/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā d+ya āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon dang zhabs bsil dbul/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyi gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrub// oṃ ag+na ye gats+tsha zhes dang*/ dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed de/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// de nas rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs gnas gsum bsrungs te bsngo ba smon lam dang bkra shis ci shes bya'o// drug pa ni/ mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa yin na me ma shi'i bar du mi bsgul/ shi ba dang gzhan reg tu mi gzhug par rang gis phyags la gnas dben par bskyal/ thun mong gi dngos grub tsam la 'phral du phyags la thab kyi shul dang*/

nye 'khor thams cad dri zhim po'i chus byugs te me tog la sogs pa gtor la bkra shis par bya'o// smras pa/ las nyon drwa bas 'dzings pa'i sdig sgrib kyi// tshang tshing ming du byed pa'i byin za la// ye shes zhi ba'i sreg blugs zhes grags pa'i// cho ga'i tshul de bshad pas dge gyur cig/ ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ ngo mtshar phan bde'i do shal ngoms pa yi// lha sngags ye shes rol pa'i lang tsho ma// phun tshogs shis pa'i rgyang glu sa gsum na// sgrog byed cho ga'i rim pa gnyis par dge /gnyis pa bsnyen pa las rung song zhing dam ldan gyi rnal 'byor pas/ rang gzhan gyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phyir du rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya ba'i tshul la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po la'ang drug gi dang po thab ni sa'i cho ga byas shing*/ nyams dga' la bkra shis pa'i gnas su rang nyid kha byang bltas kyis 'dug pa'i mdun gyi gzhi der thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la/ srad bu khru gang gi tshad kyi dbus nas tshangs thig la shar nub tu mtshan ma byas la/ de'i bar gyi srad bu de g.yon pas mtshan ma'i steng du gzung*/ g.yas pas lho byang gi zur thig la ri mo byas te nub la yang rigs 'gre'o// de steng thig bzhi btab pas thab nang dang*/ de'i phyi rol du shar nub la sor brgyad pa gnyis kyis mtshan ma byas la/ rtags nang ma nas dbus kyi bar gyi srad bu des zur thig bzhi la mtshan ma byas te de steng thig btab pas kha khyer 'byung*/ yang rtags phyi ma nas dbus kyi bar gyi srad bus sngar ltar zur thig bzhi la mtshan ma byas te/ de'i steng thig btab pas mu ran 'byung ngo*// thab stegs kyi thig mi dgos so// thab nang gi dbus nas sum gnyis phyir bzhag pa'i sum cha zlum por bskor ba pad lte dang*/ phyi'i sum gnyis la gcus thig gdab pas pad 'dab bya/ thab kyi gzhi thams cad kha dog ser po bya zhing*/

kha khyer mu ran gang rung la rin po che'i phreng bas bskor/ kha dog 'dres pa'i skyon spang ba'i phyir bcad tshon thams cad dang*/ rin po che'i kha dog li khri bya/ dbus su nyi gdan gyi steng du tshom bu sngon po dgod/ gnyis pa bud shing ni/ tsher ma can gyi shing ma yin pa/ shug pa dang star ka sogs 'bras bu can gyi shing ser zhing dri zhim po'i dbus kyi cha las byung ba'am/ de med na srog chags med pa'i nags kyi lci ba thab kyi kha khyer gyi steng nas dpangs khru gang tsam gru bzhir brtsegs pa'i nang gi shar lho'i mtshams su ting lo che ba gru bzhi gcig kyang bsham mo// gsum pa sbar ba me ni/ dge 'dun gyi bsro khang ngam rgyal po'i khyim gyi mes bya'o// bzhi pa rdzas ni/ yam shing 'bras bu can gyi shing ser zhing dri zhim pa sbom phra gung mo tsam/ ring thung khru gang pa rtsa rtse mar dang sbrang rtsis sbags pa dang*/ mar khu/ zas mchog til sogs rdzas gzhan rnams zhi ba dang 'dra zhing*/ gtor ma dang rdzas rnams yung ba sogs kyis ser por kha bsgyur bar bya'o// lnga pa bsham thabs ni/ thab kyi mtha' skor thams cad byi dor legs par byas la dri bzang pos byug de'i lho nas kha byang bltas su rang gi stan nang tshangs can kha dog ser po'i steng du sa 'ja' li dang*/ rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas na chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis dang bcas pa bsham/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon na yam shing*/ mar khu/ zas mchog til sogs bsham thabs zhi ba dang 'dra/ drug pa sgrub pa po ni/ nyi dros dus gos rgyan ser pos brgyan la tshe dpal ye shes rgyas par 'dod pa'i bsam pas kha byang du bltas te khri'u shing la byams bzhugs kyi 'dug go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la drug gi dang po bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim gyi bar ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o// 'di nas brtsams te sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub kyi bar du lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' ba la bslab/

gnyis pa me btsal zhing sgrub pa ni/ dpal 'bar che ba zhig la gong du bshad pa'i me sbar te/ yam shing mar la sbags pa'am/ rtswa skam po gzhan dang bcas pa lag pa gnyis kas gus pa'i tshul gyis thab la g.yas nas gru bzhir bskor zhing ngag tu/ hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa lan gsum dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod de thab kyi nang gi ting lo sbar nas me gso/ de nas khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa'i mtheb mdzub kyi rtse sbyar ba rin chen khu tshur gyi phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung la/ blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg cing*/ blugs gzar gyi mar khus bud shing la khyab par blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod/ gsum pa thab dang yo byad bsang ba ni/ bsang chu la dmigs te/ oṃ a mṛ tes bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sham̐ las byung ba'i dung phor dri ma med pa'i nang du/ bsang chu rdzas dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa lan bdun gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ de nas ku sha'i 'thor yab kyis rdzas dang yo byad thab bcas la gtor zhing*/ a mṛ te brjod pas bgegs bsal/ swa bhā was bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas rnams stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsreg rdzas dang*/ mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha mnyes pa dang*/ so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hās yam shing*/ oṃ shrī swā hās mar/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hās 'bru/ oṃ swa swā hās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas thams cad sbyangs/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ aḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da'i bar/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta sogs rol mo dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab bo// bzhi pa thab khung mngon par 'du bya ba ni/

thab swa bhā was stong par sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rgyas pa'i thab khung ser po rgyar khru do pa zabs su khru gang pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa kha khyer ram mu ran la rin po che'i phreng bas mtshan pa bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur ces brjod/ lha la 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las me lha ra skyes la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ser po las 'od zer ser po 'phro ba/ gsus khyim che ba ral pa'i thor tshugs can ag tshom 'phyang ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod pa dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya/ de nas lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar gzhag mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ag+na ye e h+ye hi zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod pa pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas chu gnyis phul la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod nas thab dbus kyi dam tshig pa la bstim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas dbang lha spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa'i mtshan sngags re re mgor sbyar ba'i nyer spyod/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes btags pas nang mchod dang*/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams te/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig /oṃ badz+ra sa twa a/ zhes brjod de thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas skor du dgram mo// de nas gzar bu gnyis rin chen khu tshur gyi phyag rgyas gzung*/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐ dang dgang blugs kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang ram̐ gyis mtshan par bsams te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes bdun brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī bya dī bya ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba ha nā ya swā hā/

zhes brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul la bar der me pra brtags te ngan na hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsang chus phyogs kun gtor te bgegs bsal/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod la/ de nas bsreg rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin du 'bul dgos pas/ thog mar rdzas rnams lag pa g.yon pas bzung la/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas blang zhing cung zad bskor te mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul/ de yang yam shing byang chub kyi shing du mos te/ oṃ ag+na

lha sngags ye swā hā/ oṃ bo dhi rdzas sngags bṛk+ṣā ya bdag dang las sngags sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes pas tshar gcig dang*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā lan lnga/ yang lha sngags/ rdzas sngags/ las sngags bcas spel ba tshar gcig bcas khyon bdun nam nyer gcig sogs 'bul na'ang des rigs 'gre'o// spel tshig ni bshad ma thag pa ltar yin pas/ des 'og ma rnams la yang rigs 'gre byas la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hās mar dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hās zas mchog dang*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hās til dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hās 'bras so dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hās 'bras dang*/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hās nas dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hās gro dang*/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hās sran ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hās dūr+wa dang*/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya swā hās ku sha rnams phul la/ sde tshan re re'i gong 'og tu lha sngags rdzas sngags las sngags sogs sbyor tshul gong ltar shes par bya'o// de ltar me lha la bsreg rdzas ji tsam 'byor pa phul ba'i mthar gong ltar mchod bstod byas la/ yang gong bzhin/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis chu gnyis dbul/ mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blugs te oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod la/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo// drug pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su dri ma med pa'i hūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin dang*/ sku las mdangs dang 'od zer ser po 'phro ba dang*/ de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs nas/ sa mā dzaḥzhes pa'i bar yang sgrub thabs bzhin la/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas bya/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdor dril 'dzin pas/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa yi// chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang*// thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// zhes dang*/

ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// zhes sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā ri e h+ye his spyan drangs la/ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sogs dbang lha spyan 'dren sgrub thabs bzhin las/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// lha de nyid 'dzum zhing tshim la 'od zer ser po 'phro ba dang gzi mdangs dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor la sogs pa rgyas pa'i las mdzad par bsam/ slar yang hūm̐ zhes brjod cing thab dang yo byad thams cad la bsang chu gtor te mi gtsang ba dang nyes pa thams cad dag par bsam mo// de nas gzar bu gnyis blangs te lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs par bsam pa sogs sngar ltar gsal btab ste/ hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa ces tshar kha shas brjod/ de nas oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes pa lan bdun gyis blugs gzar gyis mar blugs pas dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī pyā dī pya zhes sogs kyi mthar/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam/ de lta bu gsum la sogs pas byon skyems phul la/ de nas/ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs mtshan sngags re re bzhin sbyar ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod dbul/ dpal chen nam mkha'i sogs sh+lo ka gnyis kyis bstod/ de nas yam shing sngar bzhin bzung ste/ hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa tshar gsum tsam dang*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po sogs gong bzhin dang bcas te tshar gcig de nas oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā rkyang pas ji tsam 'os pa phul ba'i mthar slar yang*/

hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya bdag dang sogs tshar gcig dbul/ de bzhin du rdzas gzhan ma rnams la yang rigs 'gres te shes par bya/ grangs ni brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ rdzas kyi gtso bo zas mchog la grangs bzung ste brgya stong sogs 'bul ba ma gtogs 'dra zhing sgrub g.yog gcig gis grangs gzung*/ de yang spyir btang bsod nams rgyas pa tsam la gong du bshad pa ltar khyad par gyi rdzas zas mchog gis bya la/ dmigs bsal so sor spro na/ tshe rgyas pa gtso bor byed na dūr+wa'i rtse mar dang sbrang rtsis spags pa/ 'byor pa rgyas pa la 'bras so ba sogs sad ser sogs kyi skyon dang bral ba'i 'bru sna tshogs/ shes rab rgyas par gsar zhing dri bsung zhim po dang ldan pa'i me tog ser po'am dkar pos bya/ sngags rdzas sngags sam/ me tog lta bu'i rdzas sngags dmigs bsal med pa la lha sngags kyis dbul/ spel tshig bsod rnams rgyas pa la/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po'i puṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du tshe rgyas pa la/ ā yur puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ 'byor pa rgyas pa la/ shrī bhū ti puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ shes rab rgyas pa la/ pradzñā puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes sbyar bas mtshon te shes par bya zhing*/ brgya rtsa brgyad re'i mtshams su spel tshig re nges par gdags la thun rer ji tsam nus pa dbul/ me rgyun ma chad tsam gyi bud shing yang gzhug go /de yang yam shing ni me 'od 'bar ba la/ zhu ba'i rdzas rnams ni lha'i zhal du/ gong bu'i rdzas rnams ni phyag tu/ ku sha ni dbu'i gtsug tor la phul bar bsam mo// bsreg rdzas rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ gong byon skyems skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang gzar gsum dbul/ de nas mchod pa rnams kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs te phyi mchod rnams/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di// zhes dang*/ zhabs bsil 'di zer nas 'don pa bsgyur ba ma gtogs gzhan kye rdor bzhin bya'am/

'jig rten khams ni dpag med ni// zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pas mchod/ bsdu na sngags mchod rkyang pas kyang rung*/ gong bzhin nang mchod dang bstod pa bya/ de nas gtor ma dang po la chab kyis bran te/ a mṛ tes bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ ye shes lnga rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i a kā ro btags pa lan gsum sogs kyis dbul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi nang gi mchod pa bstod pa bcas kyi mthar/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar bya/ mthar thal mo sbyar te/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang longs spyod la sogs pa rnam par 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes sogs rang gi yid la gang 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang zhes sogs dang*/ bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas sems sgrib pa dang ldan pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang gis cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa thams cad bzod par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs kyi rjes la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥzhes dang*/ mtheb srin gyi se gol gyis sgras/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ srin lag gis thab kyi dbus nas thal ba cung zad blangs la dpral bar bskus te/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// gsum pa rjes la drug las/ dang po me lha lhag mas mchod pa ni/

thab khung du mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg pa dang bcas pas blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod de/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsams la/ bsreg rdzas rnams kyi lhag ma bdun nam bcu gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor phul mthar/ byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gang ba'i sbyin sreg tu dbul/ yon bdag la sogs pa'i don du byed pa'i tshe spro na/ de'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong dgang gzar dang lhan cig tu bzung la gang ba'i sbyin sreg phul ba'i mthar/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes bdun tshan gsum po re re'i mthar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ gtor ma gnyis pa de nyid la chab bran te bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsum la sogs pas byin gyis brlab/ lag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogs gsum mam lngas phul la/ mthar mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyi bstod pa sh+lo ka gcig gi mthar/ spro na/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras sogs gong zhi ba'i sbyin sreg nang ltar gyis bstod do// gsum pa ni/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams dang longs spyod la sogs pa rnams 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ bzhi pa dang lnga pa go rim cung zad kha bsgyur te/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskangs la/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon dang*/ zhabs bsil dbul/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyi gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrub// oṃ ag+na ye gats+tsha zhes dang*/

dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed de/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ de nas rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs gnas gsum bsrungs te/ bsngo smon dang*/ bkra shis ci shes bya'o// drug pa ni/ mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa yin na me ma shi'i bar du mi bsgul/ shi ba dang gzhan reg tu mi gzhug par rang gis phyags la gnas dben par bskyal/ thun mong gi dngos grub tsam la 'phral du phyags la thab kyi shul dang*/ nye 'khor thams cad dri zhim po'i chus byugs te/ me tog la sogs pa gtor la bkra shis par bya'o// smras pa/ sngon med dge mtshan rgyas pa'i chu skyes sbubs// rnam par grol byed 'od rnon skyugs mkhas pa'i// ye shes ag+ni'i las kyi srid pa'i mig /rang 'dra'i blo dman yongs la mkho phyir spel// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ sngon bsags bsod nams stobs kyis bkug min kyang*// rgyud sde'i las mtha'i 'phrul gyi khab len rdos// lcags rdul ji bzhin srid gsum dbang byed pa'i// cho ga'i tshul de 'di ni gsum par dge /gsum pa bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i dam ldan gyis srid gsum gyi 'gro ba gang zhig dbang du bya ba'i phyir/ dbang gi me mchod 'di nyid bya ba la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po la drug gi dang po thab ni/ sa chog sngon du song zhing bkra shis pa'i gnas su rang nyid kha nub bltas kyis 'dug pa'i mdun gyi gzhi der thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la/ dbus su khru phyed kyis zlum por bskor/ de'i dbus nas shar du sor gsum dor ba'i sar thab kyi dbus kyi mtshan ma byas la der g.yon pas thig skud gzung*/ g.yas pa dkar cal gyis nub kyi zlum skor gyi bar du bzung ba'i sras bu des/ me nas dbang ldan gyi bar du g.yas su bskor/ de'i phyi ru nub nas tshangs thig la sor bzhi'i rtags gnyis byas pa'i dang po sngar bzhin bskor bas kha khyer dang*/

gnyis pa de bzhin du bskor bas mu ran te/ so so'i rtse thig gis sbrel bas zla gam gyi dbyibs so// de'i phyi rol du nub kyi mtshan ma nas dbus kyi bar gyi srad bu des bden bral dang*/ rlung gi thig la rtags byas te shar la yang de'i rigs pa rtags byas nas de steng thig btab pas thab stegs gru bzhir 'byung zhing*/ de'i phyi rol du yang nub dang shar la sor bzhi'i mtshan ma byas la de dang dbus kyi bar gyi srad bu des zur bzhir rtags byas nas/ de steng thig btab pas gru bzhir 'byung ste thab stegs kyi cho ga'o// thab nang gi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad zhi ba dang 'dra/ gzhi tshon kha dog dmar por bya/ kha khyer mu ran gang rung la lcags kyu'i phreng bas bskor/ kha dog 'dres pa'i skyon spang ba'i phyir bcad tshon kha dog dkar por bya/ dbus su nyi gdan gyi steng du tshom bu sngon po dgod/ gnyis pa bud shing ni/ tsan+dan dmar po dang mdzo mo shing dang 'ol se sogs kha dog dmar zhing ro skyur ba'am/ de ma rnyed na srog chags med pa'i nags kyi lci ba thab kyi kha khyer gyi steng du zla gam gyi dbyibs su mtho gang tsam brtsigs pa'i nang gi shar lhor ting lo zla gam gyi dbyibs can kyang gzhag go /gsum pa sbar ba me ni/ smad 'tshong ma'i khyim gyi mes bya'o// bzhi pa rdzas ni/ yam shing gi rgyu bud shing dang 'dra ba las sbom phra srin mdzub tsam/ ring thung sor brgyad pa/ rtsa rtse ma nyams pa mar dang sbrang rtsis sbags pa/ mar khu/ me tog dmar po'am/ 'bras dmar po gang rnyed/ zas mchog til/ so ba/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ dūr+wa/ ku sha rnams dang*/ gzhan yo byad thams cad 'dra zhing gtor ma dang rdzas rnams ni smug rtsi sogs kyis dmar por bya'o// lnga pa bsham thabs ni/ thab kyi nye 'khor thams cad byi dor legs par byas la dri zhim pos byug de'i shar nas kha nub tu phyogs pas rang gi gdan ji ltar 'os pa gding*/

rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas ni chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis dang bcas pa bsham/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon na yam shing*/ mar khu/ me tog dmar po'am 'bras dmar/ zas mchog til/ so ba/ nas sogs bsham/ drug pa sgrub pa po ni/ dgong mo'i dus gos rgyan dmar pos brgyan/ dbang du byas pa'i bsam pas sngar bshams pa'i stan la kha nub tu bltas te/ rkang mthil gnyis kha sbyar ba pad+ma'i skyil krung gis 'dug go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la drug gi dang po bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim gyi bar ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ 'di nas brtsams te sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub kyi bar du lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' ba las bslab par bya'o// gnyis pa me btsal zhing bsgrub pa ni dpal 'bar che ba zhig la gong du bshad pa'i me sbar te/ yam shing mar la sbags pa'am/ rtswa skam po gzhan dang bcas lag pa gnyis kas gus pa'i tshul gyis thab kyi dbyibs dang mthun par g.yas su bskor zhing ngag tu hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa lan gsum dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod de thab kyi nang gi ting lo sbar la me gso/ de nas khu tshur bcangs pa'i mtheb mdzub gnyis kha phye la mdzub mo gzhan rnams kyang de'i rigs 'gros kyis cung zhig kha phye ba pad+ma'i khu tshur gyi phyag rgyas dgang gzar bzung la/ phyag rgya de bzhin gyis blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg cing*/ blugs gzar gyi mar khus bud shing la khyab par blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod/ gsum pa thab dang yo byad bsang ba ni/ bsang chu la dmigs te a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sham̐ las byung ba'i dung phor dri ma med pa'i nang du bsang chu rdzas dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/

oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa lan bdun gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ de nas ku sha'i 'thor yab kyis rdzas dang yo byad thab bcas la 'thor zhing*/ oṃ a mṛ te brjod pas bgegs bsal/ swa bhā was bsreg rdzas dang*/ mchod rdzas rnams stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsreg rdzas dang*/ mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha mnyes pa dang*/ so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hās yam shing*/ oṃ shrī swā hās mar/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hās 'bru/ oṃ swa swā hās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas thams cad sbyangs/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da'i bar dang*/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta sogs rol mo bcas kyi byin gyis brlab par bya'o// bzhi pa thab khung mngon par 'du bya ba ni/ thab swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i dbang gi thab khung dmar po zla gam rgyar khru gang pa/ zabs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer dang mu ran sor bzhi pa/ kha khyer la lcags kyu'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ de'i phyi rol du stegs bu gru bzhi ba'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ces brjod/ lnga pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las me lha ra skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po/

zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dmar po las 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba/ gsus khyim che ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ ag tshom 'phyang ba/ drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar gzhag mdzub mos gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ag+na ye e h+ye hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod la pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas chu gnyis phul la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod la thab dbus kyi dam tshig pa la bstim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas dbang lha spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa'i mtshan sngags re re mgor sbyar ba nyer spyod dang*/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes btags pas nang mchod dang*/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg

/'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams te/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig /oṃ badz+ra satwa a/ zhes brjod de thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas skor du dgram mo// de nas gzar bu gnyis pad+ma'i khu tshur gyi phyag rgyas bzung ste/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐ dang*/ dgang blugs kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang ram̐ gyis mtshan par bsams te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes lan bdun brjod cing*/ mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī pyā dī pyā ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba ha nā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam mo// de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul la bar der me pra brtags te ngan na hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsang chus phyogs kun tu gtor te bgegs bsal lo// de nas oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod la/ de nas bsreg rdzas rim bzhin 'bul dgos pas thog mar rdzas rnams lag pa g.yon pas bzung la/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas blang zhing cung zad bskor te/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul/ de yang yam shing byang chub kyi shing du mos te/ oṃ ag+na

lha sngags ye swā hā/ oṃ bo dhi rdzas sngags bṛk+ṣā ya/ rgyal po las sngags dang*/ yul 'khor dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa'i 'gro ba thams cad wā shaṃ ku ru hoḥzhes pa tshar gcig dang*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā lan lnga/ yang lha sngags rdzas sngags/ las sngags spel ba tshar gcig bcas khyon bdun nam nyer gcig sogs 'bul na'ang des rigs 'gre'o// spel tshig ni bshad ma thag pa ltar yin pas des 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre byas la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hās mar dang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hās 'bras dmar ram/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hās me tog dmar po dang*/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hās zas mchog dang*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hās til dang*/ oṃ badz+ra bi dz+wa ya swā hās 'bras so dang*/ oṃ ma hā be ga ya swā hās nas dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hās gro dang*/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hās sran ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hās dūr+wa dang*/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya swā hās ku sha rnams phul la/ sde tshan re re'i gong 'og tu lha sngags/ rdzas sngags/ las sngags sogs sbyor tshul gong ltar shes par bya'o// de ltar me lha la bsreg rdzas ji tsam 'byor pa phul ba'i mthar/ gong ltar mchod bstod byas la/ yang gong bzhin/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis chu gnyis dbul/ mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod la/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo// drug pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su dri ma med pa'i hūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin dang*/ sku las mdangs dang 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs nas/ sa mā dzaḥzhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin la rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bcas bya/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdor dril 'dzin pas/

ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// zhes sogs kyi mthar oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye his spyan drangs la/ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sogs dbang lha spyan 'dren sgrub thabs bzhin las/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// lha de nyid chags pa'i nyams dang ldan zhing 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas rgyal po dang*/ yul 'khor dang paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa thams cad chags shing 'dun pa'i las mdzad par bsams la/ slar yang hūm̐ zhes brjod cing thab dang*/ yo byad thams cad la bsang chu gtor te mi gtsang ba'i nyes pa thams cad dag par bsam mo// de nas gzar bu gnyis blangs te lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs par bsam pa sogs sngar ltar gsal btab ste/ hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa ces tshar kha shas brjod/ de nas oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pa lan bdun gyis blugs gzar gyis mar blugs pas dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī pyā dī pya zhes sogs kyi mthar/ rgyal po dang*/ yul 'khor dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa'i 'gro ba thams cad wā shaṃ ku ru hoḥzhes brjod de/ gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar te lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum la sogs pas byon skyems phul la/ de nas/ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs mtshan sngags re re bzhin sbyar ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod dbul/ dpal chen nam mkha'i sogs sh+lo ka gnyis kyis bstod/ de nas yam shing sngar bzhin zung ste/ hūm̐ badz+ra lha sngags phaṭa tshar gsum tsam dang*/ oṃ bo dhi rdzas sngags bṛk+ṣā ya/ rgyal po las sngags dang*/ yul 'khor sogs gong bzhin dang bcas te tshar gcig dang*/ de nas/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā rkyang pas ji tsam 'os pa phul ba'i mthar/

slar yang hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya/ rgyal po dang*/ yul 'khor sogs tshar gcig dbul/ de bzhin du rdzas gzhan ma rnams la yang rigs 'gres te shes par bya'o// grangs ni rdzas gzhan ma rnams lnga bcu re dang*/ gtso bor lha sngags dang me tog dmar po'am/ 'bras dmar po la grangs 'dzin cing lnga bcu re song ba dang*/ spel tshig re brjod pa de 'dra bas brgya stong sogs ci nus 'bul ba ma gtogs 'dra zhing*/ sgrub g.yog gcig gis grangs bzung la/ me rgyun ma chad tsam gyi bud shing yang gzhug go /de yang yam shing ni me 'od 'bar ba la/ zhu ba'i rdzas rnams ni lha'i zhal du/ gong bu'i rdzas rnams ni phyag tu/ ku sha ni dbu'i gtsug tor la phul bar bsam mo// bsreg rdzas rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ gong byon skyems skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang gzar gsum dbul/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs te/ phyi mchod rnams/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di// zhes dang*/ zhabs bsil 'di zer nas 'don pa bsgyur ba ma gtogs gzhan kye rdor bzhin bya'am/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag tu med na sogs sam/ bsdu na sngags mchod rkyang pas kyang rung*/ gong bzhin nang mchod dang bstod pa bcas bya/ de nas gtor ma dang po la chab kyis bran te/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ ye shes lnga rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i a kā ro btags pa lan gsum sogs kyis dbul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa bcas kyi mthar/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar bya/

mthar thal mo sbyar te/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rgyal po dang*/ yul 'khor dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag bdag la chags shing 'dun par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs rang gi yid la gang 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang zhes sogs dang*/ bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas sems sgrib pa dang ldan pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang gis cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa thams cad bzod par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad ces sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥzhes dang*/ mtheb srin gyi se gol gyi sgras/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ srin lag gis thab kyi dbus nas thal ba cung zad blangs la dpral bar bskus te dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// gsum pa rjes la drug las/ dang po me lha lhag mas mchod pa ni/ thab khung du mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la rig pa dang bcas pas blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod de/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsams la/ bsreg rdzas rnams kyi lhag ma bdun nam bcu gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor phul mthar/ byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gang ba'i sbyin sreg tu dbul/ yon bdag la sogs pa'i don du byed pa'i tshe spro na/ de'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong dgang gzar dang lhan cig tu bzung la gang ba'i sbyin sreg lan gsum phul ba'i mthar/ rgyal po dang*/ yul 'khor dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs pa 'gro ba thams cad wā shaṃ ku ru hoḥzhes bdun tshan gsum po re re'i mthar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ gtor ma gnyis pa de nyid la chab bran te/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan gsum la sogs pas byin gyis brlab/ lag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogs gsum mam lngas phul la/ mthar mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang sogs kyi bstod pa sh+lo ka gcig gi mthar/ spro na/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// sogs gong zhi ba'i sbyin sreg nang ltar gyis bstod/ gsum pa ni/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis rgyal po dang*/ yul 'khor dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta la sogs 'gro ba thams cad bdag la chags shing 'dun par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol la/ bzhi pa dang lnga pa go rim cung zad kha bsgyur te/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi lhag chad kha bskangs la/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon dang zhabs bsil dbul/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyi gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+na ye gats+tsha zhes dang*/ dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed de/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// de nas rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs gnas gsum bsrung*/ bsngo smon dang bkra shis ci shes bya'o// drug pa ni/ rlung sems dbang du bya ba sogs mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa yin na me ma shi'i bar du mi bsgul/ shi ba dang gzhan reg tu mi gzhug par rang gis phyags la gnas dben par bskyal/ thun mong gi dngos grub tsam la 'phral du phyags la thab kyi shul dang*/ nye 'khor thams cad dri zhim po'i chus byugs te/ me tog la sogs pa gtor la bkra shis par bya'o// smras pa/ dbang byed 'od zer rā ga'i lcags kyu'i 'phrul// phra mos yid can 'gugs pa'i mthu dpal la// yid song sbyor dngos rjes tshang cho ga 'di// srid gsum dbang du bya ba'i don du bris//

༈ /oṃ swa sti/ mthu stobs rno myur gtum drag rdo rje'i thog /phyi nang gsang dgra'i yid srubs dpung 'joms mtshon// 'bebs byed gsang chen theg pa'i las mtha'i rim// drag po hom gyi cho ga bzhi par dge /'dir bsnyen pa las rung song zhing dam ldan gyi rnal 'byor pas bstan pa dang sems can sogs la gnod byed kyi gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'i phyir/ drag po'i sreg blugs bya ba'i tshul la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po la drug gi dang po thab ni/ dben zhing nyams dga' la sa chog byas pa'i gnas su/ rang nyid kha lhor bstan gyis 'dug pa'i mdun gyi gzhi der thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la/ de nas sor drug dang gsum gnyis kyi tshad kyis lan gnyis bskor bas thab nang dang*/ de'i phyi ru sor drug pa gnyis kyis lan gnyis bskor bas kha khyer dang mu ran 'byung*/ zlum skor gnyis pa dang lho'i tshangs thig 'dzom pa nas g.yon pas srad bu bzung ste/ de nas dbus kyi bar gyi srad bu des g.yas g.yon kyi zlum skor gnyis pa'i gang sleb la mtshan ma byas pas thab nang dang*/ de bzhin du zlum skor gsum pa dang bzhi pa la yang snga ma'i rigs 'gre sbyar la mtshan ma bya/ de steng thig rnams btab pas gru gsum rim pa gsum 'byung bas thab nang dang kha khyer dang mu ran 'byung ngo*// de'i phyi rol du lho byang gi zlum skor phyi ma dang tshangs thig 'dzom pa nas/ dbus kyi srad bu des zur thig bzhi dang*/ de'i phyi rol du yang sor bzhi'i mtshan ma byas te/ de nas gong bzhin zur thig la rtags byas pa'i steng thig btab pas thab stegs dpangs dang bcas pa 'byung bar bshad cing*/ nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad sogs 'dra/ thab kyi gzhi thams cad tshon kha dog nag po dang*/ kha khyer mu ran gang rung la rdo rje rtse gsum pa rwa gdengs pa'i phreng ba dang*/ bcad tshon thams cad kha dog sngo skyas bya zhing*/ dbus kyi nyi gdan gyi steng du tshom bu sngon po dgod/

gnyis pa bud shing ni/ tsher ma can gyi shing nag po'am/ bong bu dang rnga mong gi sbang sogs kyis gru gsum du brtsigs pa'i nang gi 'jig rten pa'i shar lhor ting lo gru gsum zhig kyang bsham/ gsum pa sbar ba me ni/ shan pa'i khyim gyi me'am/ rdo lcags gtsubs pa las byung ba'i mes bya'o// bzhi pa rdzas ni/ yam shing nag cing 'khyogs pa dri mi zhim pa sbom phra mthe'u chung tsam dang*/ tshad sor bcu pa brgya lhag tsam/ gzhan yang*/ mar khu/ sha khrag dug sna sogs khyad par gyi rdzas dang*/ til nag zas mchog sogs rdzas gzhan thams cad 'dra'o// lnga pa bsham thabs ni/ thab kyi nye 'khor thams cad byi dor legs par byas la khrag sna dang dug sna sogs kyis byug de'i byang nas kha lhor bltas su rang gi stan dang*/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon na chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis dang bcas pa bsham/ rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas na yam shing dang*/ mar khu dang*/ khyad par gyi rdzas dang*/ til sogs bsham/ drug pa sgrub pa po ni/ nam phyed nyin phyed gang rung la/ khrus byas gos rgyan nag pos brgyan/ gdug pa can bsgral 'dod kyi bsam pas sngar bshams pa'i stan la kha lhor bltas te g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pa'i phyed krung gis 'dug go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la drug gi dang po bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim gyi bar ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o// 'di nas brtsams te sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub kyi bar du lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' ba la bslab par bya/ gnyis pa me btsal zhing sgrub pa ni/ dpal 'bar che ba zhig la gong du bshad pa'i me sbar te/ yam shing mar la sbags pa'am/ rtswa skam po gzhan dang bcas pa'i lag pa gnyis kas gus pa'i tshul gyis thab la g.yon nas gru gsum du bskor zhing*/

ngag tu hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa lan gsum dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod de thab kyi nang gi ting lo sbar te me gso/ de nas lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur bcang*/ mdzub mo bsgreng ba khro bo'i khu tshur gyi phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung la/ blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg cing*/ blugs gzar gyi mar khus bud shing la khyab par blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod/ gsum pa thab dang yo byad bsang ba ni/ bsang chu la dmigs te/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sham̐ las byung ba'i dung phor dri ma med pa'i nang du/ bsang chu rdzas dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ de nas ku sha'i 'thor yab kyis rdzas dang yo byad thab bcas la 'thor zhing*/ oṃ a mṛ te brjod pas bgegs bsal/ swa bhā was bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas rnams stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsreg rdzas dang*/ mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha mnyes pa dang*/ so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hās yam shing*/ oṃ shrī swā hās mar/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swā hās 'bru/ oṃ swa swā hās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas thams cad sbyangs/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta sogs rol chen bcas kyis byin brlab bo// bzhi pa thab khung mngon par 'du bya ba ni/ thab swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i drag po'i thab khung nag po zur gsum pa/

rgyar sor nyi shu/ zabs su sor bcu pa/ kha khyer dang mu ran sor gsum pa/ kha khyer la rdo rje rtse gsum pa rwa gdengs pas mtshan pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ de'i phyi rol du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur ces brjod la/ lnga pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las me lha ra skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor nag po las 'od zer nag po 'phro ba/ gsus khyim che ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ ag tshom 'phyang ba/ drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar gzhag mdzub mos gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ag+na ye e h+ye hi zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod la pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas chu gnyis phul la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod la thab dbus kyi dam tshig pa la bstim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes dang*/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas dbang lha spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa'i mtshan sngags re re mgor sbyar ba'i nyer spyod dang*/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta sogs rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas nang mchod dang*/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍa kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa ldan par gyur bsams te/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig /oṃ badz+ra satwa a/ zhes brjod de thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas skor du dgram mo// de nas gzar bu gnyis khro bo'i khu tshur gyi phyag rgyas bzung ste/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐ dang*/ dgang blugs kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang ram̐ gyis mtshan par bsams te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes lan bdun brjod cing*/ mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī pyā dī pya ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba ha nā ya swā hā/

zhes brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la/ me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam mo// de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul la/ bar der me pra brtags te ngan na hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsang chus phyogs kun tu gtor te bgegs bsal/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod la/ de nas bsreg rdzas rnams rim bzhin 'bul dgos pas/ thog mar rdzas rnams lag pa g.yas pas bzung la g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas blang zhing cung zad bskor te mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul/ de yang yam shing byang chub kyi shing du mos te/ oṃ ag+na

lha sngags ye swā hā/ oṃ bo dhi rdzas sngags bṛk+ṣā ya/ bstan pa dang las sngags rnal 'byor pa dang*/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos rnams la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces tshar gcig dang*/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā lan lnga/ yang lha sngags rdzas sngags las sngags spel ba tshar gcig bcas khyon bdun nam nyer gcig sogs 'bul na'ang des rigs 'gre/ spel tshig ni bshad ma thag pa ltar yin pas/ 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre byas pas/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hās mar dang*/ yang oṃ ag+na ye swā hās khyad par gyi rdzas dang*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hās til/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hās zas mchog oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hās so ba/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hās 'bras/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hās nas dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hās gro dang*/ oṃ ma hā ba lā ya swā hās sran ma dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hās dūr+wa dang*/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya swā hās ku sha rnams phul la sde tshan re re'i gong 'og tu/ lha sngags/ rdzas sngags/ las sngags sogs sbyor tshul gong ltar shes par bya'o// de ltar me lha la bsreg rdzas ji tsam 'byor pa phul ba'i mthar mchod bstod byas la/ yang gong bzhin/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis chu gnyis dbul/ mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod la/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo// drug pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su dri ma med pa'i hūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin dang*/ rab tu 'phros pa'i sku las mdangs dang 'od zer nag po 'phro ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs nas/ sa mā dzaḥzhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin la rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bcas bya/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdor dril 'dzin pas/

ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// zhes sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā ri e h+ye his spyan drangs la/ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sogs dbang lha spyan 'dren sgrub thabs bzhin las/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo// lha de nyid shin tu khro zhing 'od zer nag po spro bsdu'i sgo nas bstan 'gro la gnod pa'i gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i las mdzad par bsams la/ slar yang hūm̐ zhes brjod cing thab dang*/ yo byad thams cad la bsang chus gtor te mi gtsang ba dang nyes pa thams cad dag par bsam mo// de nas gzar bu gnyis blangs te lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs par bsam pa sogs sngar ltar gsal btab ste/ hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa ces tshar kha shas brjod/ de nas oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pa bdun gyis blugs gzar gyis mar blugs pas dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī pyā dī pya zhes sogs kyi mthar/ bstan pa dang*/ sems can dang*/ rnal 'byor pa dang*/ sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar te lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam/ de lta bu la sogs pas byon skyems phul la/ de nas oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs mtshan sngags re re bzhin sbyar ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod dbul/ dpal chen nam mkha'i sogs sh+lo ka gnyis kyis bstod/ de nas yam shing sngar bzhin bzung ste/ hūm̐ badz+ra lha sngags phaṭa/ tshar gsum tsam dang*/ oṃ bo dhi rdzas sngags bṛk+ṣā ya/ bstan pa las sngags dang sems can sogs tshar gcig dbul/ de bzhin du rdzas gzhan ma rnams la yang rigs 'gres te shes par bya'o// grangs ni rdzas dmangs ma rnams drug cu re dang*/

lha sngags dang khyad par gyi rdzas sha khrag dug sna dang bcas stong la sogs ci nus 'bul ba ma gtogs 'dra zhing*/ sgrub g.yog gcig gis grangs bzung la/ me rgyun ma chad tsam gyi bud shing yang gzhug go /de yang yam shing ni me 'od 'bar ba la/ zhu ba'i rdzas rnams ni lha'i zhal du/ gong bu'i rdzas rnams ni phyag tu/ ku sha ni dbu'i gtsug gtor la phul bar bsam mo// bsreg rdzas rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ gong byon skyems kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang gzar gsum dbul/ de nas mchod pa rnams kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs te/ phyi mchod rnams/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di// zhes dang*/ zhabs bsil 'di zer nas 'don pa bsgyur ba ma gtogs gzhan kye rdor ltar bya ba'am/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na sogs sam/ bsdu na sngags mchod rkyang pas kyang rung ngo*// gong bzhin nang mchod bstod pa dang bcas pa bya/ de nas gtor ma dang po la chab kyis bran te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i a kā ro btags pa lan gsum sogs kyis dbul/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa bcas kyi mthar/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar bya/ mthar thal mo sbyar te/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa dang bstan pa dang sems can la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol/

zhes sogs rang gi yid la gang 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab la skabs 'dir yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ zhes sogs dang*/ bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas sems sgrib pa dang ldan pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang gis cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa thams cad bzod par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥzhes dang*/ mtheb srin gyi se gol gyi sgras/ ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ srin lag gis thab kyi dbus nas thal ba cung zad blangs la dpral bar bskus te/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// gsum pa rjes la/ sngar gyi zhi ba ltar drug las/ dang po me lha lhag mas mchod pa ni/ thab khung du mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg pa dang bcas pas blug oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod de/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsams la/ bsreg rdzas rnams kyi lhag ma bdun nam bcu gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor phul mthar/ byon zan gyi skabs ltar/ mar dgang blugs gsum gang ba'i sbyin sreg tu dbul/ yon bdag la sogs pa'i don du byed pa'i tshe spro na/ de'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong dgang gzar dang lhan cig tu bzung la gang ba'i sbyin sreg lan gsum phul ba'i mthar/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa dang bstan pa dang sems can la gnod pa'i gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bdun tshan gsum po re re'i mthar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ gtor ma gnyis pa de nyid la chab bran te bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan gsum la sogs pas byin gyis brlab/

lag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogs gsum mam lngas dbul/ mthar mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyi bstod pa sh+lo ka gcig gi mthar/ spro na/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras sogs gong zhi ba'i sbyin sreg nang ltar gyis bstod do// gsum pa rjes ni/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bstan pa dang sems can la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol la/ bzhi pa dang lnga pa go rim cung zad kha bsgyur la/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon dang*/ zhabs bsil phul la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyi gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thabs cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+na ye gats+tsha zhes dang*/ dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed de/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// de nas rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs gnas gsum bsrungs te/ bsngo smon dang bkra shis ci shes bya'o// drug pa ni/ mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa yin na me ma shi'i bar du mi bsgul/ shi ba dang gzhan reg tu mi gzhug pa rang gis phyags la gnas dben par bskyal/ thun mong gi dngos grub tsam la 'phral du phyags la thab kyi shul dang*/ nye 'khor thams cad du dug chus byugs te me tog la sogs pa gtor la bkra shis par bya'o// smras pa/ bstan dang 'gro la 'khu ba'i gnod byed tshogs// ma lus thal bar rlog byed drag po'i me'i// sreg blugs cho ga'i tshul de bris pa'i dges// nag phyogs mtha' dag rtsad nas 'joms gyur cig /rab 'byams rgyal kun gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa// rab 'bar khro bo'i dbang phyug bgegs kyi dgra// rab 'jigs 'byung po'i bdag po mig sman mdog
