/rab mchog lhag pa'i lha khyod gtan gyi skyabs// mtshan tsam dran pa'i mod la bar chad kyi// dpung tshogs gcig car 'joms pa'i rnam 'phrul 'dis// zho 'thung mtshon cha'i dpal dran lha min mo'i// mngal lhung tshul der mtshar 'dzin byis pa'i blo// gang thugs nye ba'i gsang sngags bsnyen pa'i tshul// mthar phyin rnal 'byor mkha' lding sngon skyes mas// rab bsrubs phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'od stong can// bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i chu skyes bzhad la spro// ches dkar lhag bsam dbyu gus legs bskul ba'i// legs bshad 'chi med lha yi dun+du bhiḥ// blo ldan legs bris tshogs kyi dga' ston du// ldir ba'i tshul 'di dam pa'i drin las ci// de lta na'ang rmongs chen mun pa'i rgyas// ches phra'i blo yi yan lag dam bcings pas// ma rtogs log rtog the tshom mdud pa'i gnad// 'grol bar ma nus mkhas pa'i tshogs la bshags// 'dir brten thob pa'i dge tshogs pak+ṣu'i klung*// dus gsum bsags pa'i legs byas bye ma dang*// chab cig kun mkhyen rnam par mi rtog pa'i// ye shes rgya mtsho'i klong der thim gyur cig /ces dpal ldan gsang bdag 'byung po 'dul byed kyi las bzhi'i sbyin sreg 'di lta bu zhig sngar nas 'bri 'dun yod kyang 'di rigs rung min ma shes par brten/ 'bri ba'i rngo ma thogs te re zhig lus par nye char zhib tu brtags tshe lha 'di nyid kyi rdo rje'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gur gyi le'u bco lnga pa sogs rgyud sde gong 'og mang po nas bstan pa'i phyir/ des na kye rdo rje'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i las sgrub tshul dag 'di la sbyar kyang mi 'gal bar sems te rang 'dra'i blo dman kun la phan phyir drin can bla ma khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po sku drin mtshungs pa ma mchis pa rnams kyi zhabs rdul spyi bor 'dzin pa'i rmongs rtul 'du gsum pa gzims 'og sprul ming byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phrin las kyis lcags lug gro bzhin zla nang du bsgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni nye gnas rab ming rgan bu bstan rab kyis 'bad de bris pa dge legs su gyur cig

/slar yang bstan bcos 'di'i rtsom gzhi ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i kye dor zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang*/ thar rtse paṇa chen gyi las phyi ma gsum gyi lag len sogs la brten nas dag par bgyis shing*/ nyer mkho'i gsal byed cung zad kyang bsnan nas bris pa maṅga laṃ// ༈ /swa sti/ gong gi sbyin sreg 'di ni rgyud sde bzhi las gsungs pa'i lhag pa'i lha phal mo cher sbyar du rung bas dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos kha bsgyur tshul cung zad 'bri na/ sbyor ba'i skabs/ thab kyi dbus su lha'i bskyed chog dang mthun par pad 'dab rim can dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ chos 'byung dang*/ gzhal yas khang sogs gang dgos kyi thig lag len bzhin gdab/ lha grangs gang yod kyi phyag mtshan nam sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshon phung lha gnas ma 'chol bar bkod pa'i gtso bo'i zhal rang la bstan/ mchod rdzas chu gnyis dang*/ gsum dang*/ bzhi sogs sngon du 'gro ba gang yin rang gzhung ltar bsham/ dngos gzhi'i skabs/ bdag gi rnal 'byor lha so so'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar bya/ me sbar dus lha sngags la dz+wa la ram̐ gdags/ bsang chu rang rang gi las kyi lha dmigs bsal yod na de'i sngags kyi brlab pa'am/ spyir btang la/ a mṛ tes kyang rung*/ mchod rdzas byin rlabs kyi sngags dang*/ 'das ma 'das kyi me lhar gnas gsum byin rlabs tsam mam/ skye mched byin rlabs dang*/ go cha dgod pa sogs rang gzhung dang bstun/ 'das pa'i me lha bdag bskyed la rang gi sems nyid dang*/ rang nyid sogs kyi tshig dor zhing*/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba zhes pa'i tshab tu 'di la zhes bsgyur nas yan lag bzhi rdzogs sam/ skad cig dran rdzogs sogs rang gzhung ltar bskyed/ spyan 'dren skabs mtshan sngags dang*/ gong 'og gi lha sngags dang*/ mchod bstod gtor 'bul rnams rang rang gi gzhung ltar sbyar bas 'grub cing*/ bye brag tu rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la rdzas rnams la bdud rtsi lngas 'thor ba dang*/

nang mchod bsham pa dang 'bul ba mi dgos/ byin rlabs skabs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las sogs sbyar/ byin dbab sngags dharmā ra ṇi ta brjod srol yod/ phal cher la spro zhing nus na 'das gtor rjes cha gsum yang gtang ngo*// bya spyod gnyis la/ 'das ma 'das kyi me lha bskyed pa gong gi dkyus su gsal ba ltar bgyis kyang rung zhing*/ 'on kyang skabs 'ga' zhig tu thab bskyed pa'i skabs bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur ces pa'i mtshams su/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon sbrel la/ e h+ye hi'i bar gyis me lha spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma lā sogs kyis gdan dbul/ thab kyi dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ me lha ra skyes la zhon pa sogs nas/ drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'o zhes zhal phyag gsal gdab/ ku sha dgram/ byon skyems dbul/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs kyis bstod/ de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba sogs dkyus ltar dang*/ 'das pa'i me lha bskyed skabs/ thab dang gdan sogs bskyed nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i sogs nas e h+ye hi'i bar gyis spyan drangs/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ pad+ma ka ma lās gdan dbul/ gdan gyi steng du 'khod pa ni zhes mtshams sbyar la zhal phyag gsal gdab/ de rnams kyi'am de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs gnas gsum byin brlabs nas/ byon skyems phul ba sogs dkyus ltar la/ rjes su 'dod don la gsol ba btab rjes thab kyi thal ba cung zad srin lag gis blangs te 'bru gsum brjod cing gnas gsum du thig le byas pas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/ nongs pa bshags/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs nas oṃ badz+ra muḥs lhag pa'i lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/

de nas oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ sogs man dkyus ltar bya bar yang gsungs so// gzhan yang sngar sa'i cho ga ma byas pa'i gnas su sbyin sreg sgrub dgos na/ sa chog mdor bsdus bya ba'i tshul ni/ gang du bya ba'i sa gzhi dri bzang pos byugs la me tog gi tshom bu dgod/ dkar gtor gnyis dang mchod pa bshams la lha gang yin pa'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa byas la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pa dang oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī e h+ye hi zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis bklubs pa/ klu dang sa bdag gi tshogs kyis bskor ba skad cig gis 'thon te tshom bu'i steng du bdag la zhal phyogs te bzhugs par gyur/ mchod pa rnams rgyud sde 'og ma ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ri re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ gtor ma chus bran te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum dang*/ rin po che'i snod yangs par gtor ma 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ces dang mtshan sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis dbul/ spos dang rdor dril 'dzin pas/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das che ge mo'i sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te lha mchod pa dang*/ sems can gyi don sgrub par 'tshal na sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ lha mos/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod ci bde bar sgrubs shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas sa 'og tu gshegs par bsam mo// gtor ma gnyis pa sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha klu sa bdag gnyan la sogs pa thams cad ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ

zhes pas bkug la/ mchog sbyin gyi mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs kyis dbul/ phyogs 'dir gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ ko long dang phrag dog ma mdzad par/ zhi ba'i sems kyi bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzod cig gats+tsha zhes brjod la gtor ma gtsang sar bskyel ba ni sa bslang ba'o// tshom bu sogs bsdus la langs te sa'i dbus su lag pa gnyis bzhag cing*/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa ces dang*/ lag pas bcag cing oṃ bhū khaṃ zhes pas sa nam mkha' ltar dag par bsam pa ni sbyang ba'o// sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das che ge mo'i sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te lha mchod pa dang*/ sems can gyi don rgya chen po bsgrub par bgyi'o zhes brjod cing sems pa ni blos gzung ba ste gzung ba mdor bsdus pa'o// //sbyor ba'i skabs su zhi rgyas kyi yam shing gsher cung zad yod pa lo 'bras dang bcas pa byung na legs/ rgyas pa dang dbang gi yam shing bshad tshod bzhin ma 'byor na lcang ma lta bu yung ba dang gtsag sogs kyis kha bsgyur ba'ang thab rdugs tshe mdzad srol yod la/ 'byor pa dang spros pa shin tu che bas ni/ rdzas dang mchod gtor gyi snod dang stegs bu'i khebs/ rnal 'byor pa'i gdan/ chas gos la thod dam prog zhu/ stod g.yogs smad g.yogs bcas las so so'i mdog mthun dang*/ me tog sogs mchod gtor kyang kha dog bsgyur bar mdzad/ drag po la ni gtor ma dmar po tsam las nag po mi mdzad/ dkyus 'dir thab dang rang kha sprod byas pa ni/ kye rdor man ngag lugs sogs dang mthun par stabs bde ba'i khyad tsam yin la/ rgya bod kyi gzhung phal che bar rang dang thab gnyis ka phyogs chen du blta bar gsungs pas gang mos bya/ phyi ma'i tshe mdun du 'khod de dgang blugs sogs stob pa'i mos pa byed dgos gsungs/

dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i tshe zhi ba'i sbyin sreg yin na dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu thab bri/ rgyas pa la dkyil 'khor gyi lho/ dbang la shar/ drag po la byang du thab bri bar bya ste/ rang nyid kha blta phyogs phyogs chen du 'grig pa dang dkyil 'khor la rgyab kyis mi phyogs pa'i dgos pa yod/ dbang bskur sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg dang*/ rab gnas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi mnga' dbul dang*/ gtor zor sogs dang 'brel ba'i drag po'i sbyin sreg rnams la sbyor ba'i skabs su thab tu lha mtshan mdun bskyed ltar dang*/ rab gnas skabs rten lha gang bskyed kyi tshon phung dgod/ mdun bskyed kyi gdong du ting dang thod pa sogs me tog gis bkang ba bsham/ 'das pa'i me lha'i gzhal yas khang ngam/ pad+ma sogs gdan bskyed tshar ba'i rjes su/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ rab gnas skabs rten gyi lha'i thugs ka nas zhes dang*/ gzhan la mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas zhes bsgyur/ de'i tshe mchod g.yog pas sngar gyi me tog de gus pas blangs te grogs gzhan yod na spos dang rol mos sna drangs nas thab la g.yas phyogs nas bskor ba'i mthar me tog slob dpon la dbul/ slob dpon gyis thab tu cung zad dor zhing dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ lha rnams so so'i gdan gyi steng du 'khod pa ni zhes sogs kyis zhal phyag sku mdog phyag mtshan gsal btab nas/ lha thams cad 'dzum zhing zhi ba sogs kyi dmigs pa man chad la 'jug me tog dor tshar ba'i rjes su kha gsos la thab kyi mdun ngos su gzhag yang na thab tu dam tshig pa bskyed nas gnas gsum byin rlabs sogs byas la/ gong ltar me tog gis spyan drangs nas me tog dor ba dang mnyam du bstim/ dbang bskur ba sogs mdzad pa yod kyang snga ma gtso che/

gshegs gsol gyi tshe snga ma ltar na/ slob dpon gyis badz+ra muḥye shes pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs kar gshegs zhes brjod pa dang mnyam du mchod g.yog pas thab kyi mdun gyi me tog blangs te thab la bskor ba'i tshul gyis spos dang rol mos sna drangs te dkyil 'khor sogs la dbul/ bskyed chog byas pa yin na/ de'i rjes su dam tshig pa rang la thim zhes brjod pa ni khyad par ro// 'di rnams la bdag bskyed zur du mi dgos par sbyin sreg bya ba'i mtshams der sleb pa na/ thab kyi drung du 'khod de bsang chu sgrub pa sogs la 'jug pas chog cing las bum yod tshe bsang chu bsham sgrub gang yang mi dgos par bum chus bya/ me lha gshegs bsdu tshar ba dang oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas rang nyid bsrungs la cho ga gang yin gyi dkyus la 'jug go /zhes pa'ang nyer mkho'i yan lag tu bris pa sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
